A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Thoughtful answers.

The things you might want to know before getting in touch.

Can I discuss an existing health condition?+

Yes. Bring your questions to Dr Stevens. He will talk through the herb, ingredients and your circumstances before you decide.

Are the products available to buy?+

Browse a collection and add it to your bag. Discuss the exact herb, ingredients, suitability, availability and price with Dr Stevens before agreeing an order.

How does the enquiry bag work?+

Add a collection, adjust quantities, enter your delivery details at checkout and review the complete WhatsApp enquiry. No money is charged and no order is placed automatically. Dr Stevens will confirm the actual products, suitability, prices and delivery.

How should I use a herb?+

Ask Dr Stevens for the product details and instructions for the exact item. He will guide you on preparation, quantity and usage.

Can I take herbs with my medication?+

Tell Dr Stevens what medicines or supplements you use, and he will talk through the ingredients and suitability with you.

Do you deliver to my area?+

Ask the team to confirm delivery coverage, cost and timing for your location before placing an order.

Is a consultation enquiry a confirmed appointment?+

Consultation is free. Your WhatsApp enquiry starts a conversation; Dr Stevens can confirm a time directly with you if needed.

Where are your social media pages?+

Follow the Facebook and TikTok links in the footer on every page. Ask Dr Stevens directly for the official Instagram and YouTube accounts.
